body:
A had a great experience with a tea made from damiana, wild dagga flowers, and blue lotus.  This made me start wondering about how they would be when smoked.  I assumed that it would require too much, considering that I used alot of material in the tea.  It needed something to  boost it maybe?
Well, today I got an order in, that included dried white lily (nymphaea alba), cured wild dagga leaves (leonotis nepatefolia), kanna (sceletium tortuosum), and some other stuff. I had read that kanna is a very happy euphoric high, as was the tea I made... And after reading that the dose is very small, I really wanted to try it out.
I only had a tobacco pipe, so I cleaned that out.  I put some cured wild dagga in the bottom, just to put the kanna on top (Because the bowl is so big, and because the kanna was nearly powdered) I took one hit, burning mainly the kanna, and a little of the wild dagga, held it in for at least 25 seconds, and then slowly let it out.  By the time that happened, I was already in love.  This plant is great!  .. Super happy, floaty, melty feeling, with an obvious shift in perception, and visual changes (not hallucinations or even bending, but general visual perception).  I loved all of it.    I took another hit off of it, burning the rest of the kanna and some more of the dagga, and enjoyed the same feelings, but stronger for a while.  Then later, I added some of the white lotus on top.
Now, about an hour later, I'm feeling wonderful.  I love this stuff more than pot.  The only 'bad' side effect.. Is that I got (am) so happy, that I have been seeming pretty fruity to the people I talk to.  :)  I havent figured out what a good ratio is.. But CURED wild dagga
, kanna, and blue or white lotus.
